# Hosea Chapter 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_012_page_001.jpg

---

**12:1** Efrayim feeds ro'eh on-wind ruach and-pursues verodef the-east-wind qadim all the-day kol ha-yom; lies kazav and-desolation va-shod he-multiplies yarbeh; and-a-covenant berit with-Ashur Assyria they-make yikhrot, and-oil shemen to-Mitsrayim is-carried yuval.

**12:3** In-the-womb ba-beten he-took-by-the-heel aqav his-brother achiv, and-in-his-manhood be-ono he-strove sarah with-God elohim.

**12:6** And-you, to-your-God be-elohekha you-will-return tashuv; loyalty chesed and-justice mishpat keep shemor, and-wait veqaveh for-your-God continually tamid.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

Hosea 12 continues the prophet's exploration of the marriage metaphor — YHWH as the faithful husband, Israel as the unfaithful wife. The chapter's power lies in the intersection of personal pain and national theology.

*— PNEUMA*
